admin.indexnow.title: IndexNow
admin.indexnow.description: Tell Bing, Yandex and other IndexNow search engines about new or changed pages right away instead of waiting for their crawlers.
admin.indexnow.step_key_desc: Paste the key generated in Bing Webmaster Tools →
admin.indexnow.step_verify_desc: The site serves the key at /your-key.txt automatically — search engines read it to confirm you own the site.
admin.indexnow.key_file_bad: Not reachable yet (HTTP {status}). If you just saved, wait a minute and re-check.
admin.indexnow.step_submit_desc: Submit every page in sitemap.xml, or paste specific URLs (one per line). Resubmit only when pages change.
